items.title: Hilda Taylor Interview, 1960-10-16
items.q: And I know once Barney Bigard told me that Duke, as he called him, had bought several of those tunes from Lorenzo Tio.

ctx.x: He told me, Mr. Long, this fellow here, told me that his brother wrote Sophisticated Lady.

And I know once Barney Bigard told me that Duke, as he called him, had bought several of those tunes from Lorenzo Tio. Tio. That's right. Because Tio went up there with Piron to New York. That's right. And stayed there a few years after Piron came back.
And he sold it to Duke Ellington. Sophisticated Lady and there's something about a mood.
